title: Pictograms / Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Build recognizable metaphors from a shared construction language, because symbols must stay clear when their size or context changes.
strategic_value: The shared grid, Plex-like corners and controlled gradients can make many subjects feel related to IBM.
demonstration: The page compares productive and expressive pictograms, then pairs construction diagrams and approved examples with marked errors.
practical_value: Choose a pictogram type, construct its geometry and check contrast without treating expressive treatment as the default.

content_islands.name: Introduction and types
content_islands.spec: Place the title and resource cards above the paired productive and expressive symbols.

content_islands.name: Foundation and style
content_islands.spec: Follow with the 32px grid, padding comparisons and enlarged corner, cap and angle specimens.

content_islands.name: Stroke and detail comparisons
content_islands.spec: Pair measured strokes and viewing angles with green approval and red rejection examples.

content_islands.name: Color treatments
content_islands.spec: Compare monochrome, tinted and gradient pictograms in tabbed light-background specimens; dark states have separate captures.

content_islands.name: Expressive color construction
content_islands.spec: Finish with the masked 45° gradient layer and examples of permitted and rejected changes.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says pictograms communicate at a glance and simplify complex ideas.
reference_purposes.Expression: The symbols combine rounded exterior corners, square details and controlled color gradients.
reference_purposes.Application: Construction diagrams specify a 32px master grid and explain productive versus expressive treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page specifies 0.72px productive strokes, 1.44px expressive strokes, 1px exterior padding and contrast of 4.5:1; it prohibits perspective and radial gradients.

ingredient.name: Pictogram construction
ingredient.role: Make varied metaphors legible within a common visual family.
ingredient.application: Draw on the 32px grid; use 0.72px productive strokes and double the expressive strokes to 1.44px. Preserve the source contrast and gradient rules.
ingredient.scope: IBM pictograms, not UI icons. Additional radii and angles remain permitted when necessary to clarify the metaphor.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
